plotting_plan.title: Decoupled Wide & Deep Two-Tower System Architecture
plotting_plan.objective: System Architecture Diagram demonstrating the decoupled Wide branch (Apriori Lift MLP) and Deep branch (Two-Tower with frozen Vietnamese SBERT and User Persona embeddings) combined via additive joint scoring.

introduction_strategy.hook_hypothesis: Modern E-commerce recommender systems face severe information overload over rapidly expanding retail product catalogs, requiring sub-millisecond real-time candidate scoring.
introduction_strategy.problem_gap_hypothesis: Existing monolithic Wide & Deep architectures fail to balance explicit co-purchase rule memorization with semantic cold-start generalization without introducing heavy inference latency bottlenecks on proprietary retail datasets.
search_directions: Find highly cited papers establishing real-world impact and serving latency challenges of E-commerce recommender systems
Search for comprehensive survey papers on hybrid recommender systems and deep neural recommendation architectures
Identify foundational papers establishing two-tower retrieval networks and Wide & Deep learning paradigms

related_work_strategy.overview: Investigate three distinct recommendation paradigms to build a research graph demonstrating the necessity of our decoupled Wide (Apriori) + Deep (Two-Tower SBERT) architecture.

subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Identify standard association rule methods (Apriori) and item-based collaborative filtering baselines from foundational literature.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Memory-based association rules excel at high-confidence co-purchase memorization but suffer from severe cold-start penalties and zero generalization capability for unseen items.
limitation_search_queries: Apriori algorithm cold start limitations recommender systems
Item-based collaborative filtering sparsity cold start penalty
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: Our method integrates a Deep Two-Tower branch with SBERT embeddings to supply semantic generalization for cold-start items lacking transaction history.

subsections.methodology_cluster: Wide & Deep Learning & Neural Collaborative Filtering
subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Analyze monolithic Wide & Deep models (Cheng et al., 2016), DeepFM (Guo et al., 2017), and Neural CF (He et al., 2017).
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Monolithic hybrid networks tightly couple feature interactions, creating computational bottlenecks that prevent sub-millisecond serving without model degradation.
limitation_search_queries: Wide and Deep recommender latency serving bottleneck
Neural collaborative filtering serving overhead real-time recommendations
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: Our decoupled architecture isolates the Wide lift MLP from the Deep SBERT Two-Tower, enabling high-speed ONNX runtime optimization and sub-millisecond latency.

subsections.methodology_cluster: Two-Tower Candidate Retrieval & Language Model Embeddings
subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Examine Two-Tower architectures (Yi et al., 2019) and Sentence-BERT text embedding integrations (Reimers & Gurevych, 2019).
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Pure two-tower semantic models generalize well based on text descriptions but miss explicit high-confidence co-purchase rules present in transaction logs.
limitation_search_queries: Two tower recommendation loss of explicit co-occurrence rules
Semantic text embeddings recommendation missing co-purchase lift
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: Our Wide branch feeds log1p-normalized Apriori lift scores directly into additive joint scoring, guaranteeing high-confidence co-purchase patterns are retained.

content_bullets: Highlight the trade-off between memorization and generalization in E-commerce recommendation.
Introduce the proposed Decoupled Wide (Apriori Lift MLP) + Deep (SBERT Two-Tower) architecture.

Elaborate on retail E-commerce growth and catalog overload across 1,380 SKUs and 50,000+ interactions in a proprietary Vietnamese convenience store dataset.
Explain the tension between Wide memorization of co-purchase lift and Deep semantic generalization.
Formalize the serving latency challenge under production real-time constraints.

subsections.subsection_title: 3.3 Deep Branch: Two-Tower Network with Frozen SBERT
content_bullets: Detail User Tower: User ID embedding (64d) + Persona Cluster embedding (8d) -> Linear(72,128) -> ReLU -> LayerNorm(128) -> Linear(128,64) -> L2 Norm.
Explain User Cold-Start Fallback mechanism using global majority cluster vector and mean user embedding.
Detail Item Tower: Frozen Vietnamese SBERT (keepitreal/vietnamese-sbert, 768d) projected to 64d + Category ID (16d) + Price Bucket (8d) -> Linear(88,64) -> ReLU -> Linear(64,64) -> L2 Norm.
Define Deep Similarity Scoring S_Deep(x, y) with temperature scaling tau = 0.1.

content_bullets: Define additive joint logits: y_hat(x, y) = S_Deep(x, y) + S_Wide(x, y) and Sigmoid activation.
Formulate Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) Loss with Hard Negative Sampling (1:4 ratio, 50% top-20% high-impression distractors).
Specify Adam optimizer (learning rate 1e-3, weight decay 1e-5) and batch size 512.
